patterns.text: TALK is the governed conversation service; CHAT is the primitive, TALK is the product
COIN and TALK are optional; only INTEL (WORK) is mandatory across all principals
Every USER principal gets a governed TALK dashboard; cross-user messages via governed inbox
TALK must never operate without disclaimer — governance constraint inherited from CHAT
TALK channels are never generic; voice, disclaimer, and knowledge scope derive from industry CANON
TALK composes COIN — premium tiers (ENTERPRISE 1 COIN/turn, AGENT 3 COIN/turn) require SPEND; provider costs covered by COIN flow, not external subsidy
Axiom updated: COIN is the third primitive in TALK composition; CHAT becomes self-funding
